name: paris-bites-oms
description: Paris Bites — Inventory Management System (Angular + Express + Prisma)
//: Deliberately NOT an npm workspace. The frontend deploys to Vercel and the backend to Railway; each platform installs from its own subdirectory, and workspace hoisting would place dependencies in a root node_modules that neither build uploads. The scripts below delegate with --prefix so frontend/ and backend/ stay independently installable.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
